page: Amazon Web Services m8ine.12xlarge is an eighth-generation general-purpose instance powered by the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. Built upon dedicated x86_64 Intel processors running at 3.9 GHz, the server delivers 48 virtual CPUs mapped across 24 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory totals 192.0 GB of RAM, preserving the standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio typical of AWS general-purpose platforms with 4.0 GB allocated per thread. It operates without dedicated GPU acceleration hardware.

Network infrastructure on the m8ine.12xlarge provides a 75 Gbps baseline bandwidth alongside dedicated Elastic Block Store optimization. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, meaning persistent system volumes and dynamic scratch space rely entirely on remote network-attached storage via EBS. Public IPv4 networking requires separate configuration, as zero complimentary public addresses are assigned by default.

With its substantial 75 Gbps network interface and balanced 48-vCPU compute footprint, the configuration provides efficient resource density for distributed enterprise microservices, high-traffic web backends, CI/CD pipelines, and network-intensive database architectures that depend strictly on centralized block storage.
